resources.string:
Lets the TV remote control Melolo. Only active while Melolo is open.
Player: Up/Down = previous/next episode, Menu = episode list, OK = show pointer. Other screens: D-pad moves a pointer (hold to glide), OK clicks, hold at an edge to scroll. Hold OK to switch between player keys and pointer.
Pausing the video needs a real click (air mouse), because this TV box has no touchscreen.
Turn on \"Melolo Remote\" in this list
